label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The code in src/notifications/rollup.ts implementing the weekly rollup email logic is designed to send emails at 08:00 local time on the user's week start day (Monday). It verifies if the current time matches the send hour and if it is still the first day of the week in the user's timezone. Despite this, the Monday summary email arrives on Tuesday morning for the Sydney user, indicating a likely mismatch or miscalculation in how the time zone offset or local hour is determined.

The time checks use a localHour function and rely on startOfWeek to establish the week's start; an issue in these utilities or in the scheduling logic can cause the email to appear delayed. For example, if the actual hour check is done in UTC or another timezone context instead of the user's local timezone correctly, the email send will be offset. Further investigation into the time zone handling in localHour, startOfWeek, and their usages in this file is recommended to isolate and fix the delayed email sending for users like Sydney.
